correctness.rationale: The full quadratic equatorial trace fourth moment equals [2||A||_F²-4||An||²+3(n^TAn)²]/(d²-1) for tracefree real symmetric A, with normalized whole-sphere energy 2||A||²/[d(d+2)]. Splitting into W tracefree, e±⊗W, odd and even 2x2 blocks accounts for all d(d+1)/2-1 modes; the even generalized eigenvalue trace T_d and determinant (d+1)c²/(2d) give h±. The smallest K_d min{h_-,(1-c)/2} crosses at 3dc²+4c-d-2=0, yielding unique c*_d. The d=3 top eigenvalue must be treated separately. Independently reconstructed generalized crossing factor by SymPy and independently assembled d=3,4,5,8 fourth-moment matrices. These finite checks support the all-d structural proof.
